description: Exploratory optical comparison; metric looming uses native range and target association. Four dominant drives, 83 segments. Conditional residuals do not establish physical truth or radar measurement variance.

reference.method: ECC affine registration of the lead's rear between frames 0.5 s or 1 s apart; relative velocity = -(radar range + 3.6 m) * d ln(scale)/dt
reference.limits: daylight, in-lane leads, straight road; few windows beyond 100 m; the ACC target and the vision model may share the camera; crop, body motion, correspondence, timing, reference error and covariance are not independently bounded; repeatability is not physical accuracy

scale_check_le_40m.input_chain: Nominal .15 ground-velocity window mean minus carState.vEgo window median; not .149/B4
scale_check_le_40m.limits: Marginal regressions mix both scale errors and covariance; neither physical 1% calibration nor factory zero identified

uncertainty_code_240_7.quantity: Through-origin fit of ten decile RMS(native-ECC) summaries against mean code; includes both errors, covariance and squared bias
uncertainty_code_240_7.verification_scope: Slope, decile R2 and range-stratified rank correlation recomputed; transfer/bootstrap/AUC outputs retained from exploratory report, outside independent check

acc_target_velocity.limits: Four-estimator decomposition depends on reference and error-covariance assumptions; ACC independence not independently verified, regression coefficient not physical latency

motion_state_8_6.limits: Range-kinematics labels; physical stationarity and graded-confidence semantics unverified

camera_assisted_veto_offline.note: offline simulations of two designs; the decoder-level numbers below are the reference

camera_assisted_veto_decoder.limits: Prior-used drives, shared tuning/evaluation; window onset delays are velocity-change/deceleration equivalents, separate from actual planner replay response metrics; no physical-label or all-gates acceptance
camera_assisted_veto_decoder.window_timing_equivalent_definition: (variant window velocity minus baseline window velocity) / 1.24 m/s^2 on selected optical/base onset labels; not a measured onset timestamp

residual_definition: native minus ECC; closing below -2.5 m/s, opening above +2.5 m/s; labels are optical disagreement, not independently established false events
verification_scope: Independent arithmetic for window counts/rates, code240 pooled slope/R2/range-stratified correlation and near-scale summaries; upstream ECC and ACC independence not independently reproduced; replay outputs reused
